definition: Restated consolidated profit for the year after tax, as summarised in the issuer’s abridged prospectus. This is not EBITDA, order value or operating cash flow.
location: PDF/printed page 7 · Summary of Restated Consolidated Financial Statements; page 4 · single-segment statement
notes: FY2026 annual column, not the three-month June 2026 column. Source amounts are ₹ million, divided by 10 for ₹ crore. The issuer reports one segment. Tactical/platform product revenue and geographical revenue disclosures do not provide paired product/category profits, so no such profit allocation is shown. Prospectus financial verification does not establish current exchange admission.
insight: The annual group total is profitable on the disclosed restated basis. It does not tell us which product category earns the most, and a firm order book must not be substituted for recognised annual sales.
